source: The 'Vulnerabilities' list of WackoPicko's README.markdown (adamdoupe/WackoPicko cabc1b3), each entry mapped to the line of code it names. The admin/admin password lives in the database dump, not in code, and is left out. Fixed, with php-taint-stored-xss (9083607), before any tool ran on WackoPicko.

lines.label: Session ID: admin session cookie is an auto-incrementing id
Stored SQL injection: first name saved at registration, used unsanitized by similar.php
Directory traversal: tag field chooses the upload path
Forceful browsing: high-quality picture without a purchase
Parameter manipulation: any user's page without logging in
Reflected XSS behind JavaScript: name parameter
Logic flaw: a coupon can be applied many times
Reflected XSS behind a Flash form: value parameter
